title: Equipment Rental Registration Form
subtitle: Capture asset number, component count, approved use, and condition photo; confirm custody and return.
description: Equipment Rental records asset number, component count, approved use, condition photo, custody, and return. Equipment Rental evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this equipment rental registration and placement when staff must document asset number and component count. Reconcile approved use, condition photo, custody, and return before the equipment rental handoff. Use the rental agreement reference, asset inventory, accessory checklist, condition photos, pickup receipt, custody transfer, damage ticket, return timestamp, and deposit disposition. This rental follows a portable asset by inventory class, serial identifier, accessory kit, pickup inspection, borrower custody, deposit disposition, damage charge, and physical return. Ask the assigned equipment rental reviewer to confirm asset number against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Equipment Rental registrant details
sections.guidance: List asset and component count, approved use, pickup condition photographs, custodian, deposit reference, damage route, return time, and final condition.

sections.title: Equipment Rental decision: requested options and readiness
sections.guidance: Record requested options, prerequisites, availability, and conditions without assuming an outcome.

blocks.label: Equipment Rental registration readiness
items: Asset number is identified for this record
Component count matches the current request or source
Approved use is ready for point-of-use staff
Condition photo limits or questions are resolved
Custody is communicated to the responsible person

sections.title: Equipment Rental exception review: confirmation and next steps
sections.guidance: Confirm the accepted scope, reference, open condition, and instructions.

blocks.label: Equipment Rental registration receipt

fields.label: Event coordinator or responsible staff and date

blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms the recorded registration result and open condition.
